CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with AB 361, the Alhambra Parks and Recreation Commission meeting will not be
physically open to the public, although the public may participate by video conference or
teleconference.

To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency
and public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Webinar as follows:
Zoom Webinar direct link:

https://us06web.zoom.us/j/87639358636?pwd=SXYxMm9EQkxTb1d4L3NUWFVRaERqZz09

Find your local number: https://us06web.zoom.us/u/kMTcbjOY4
For those wishing to speak on an agenda or non-agendized item, you have 3 options for participation:
1) Pre-register to speak: Please email Maria Fregoso at mfregoso@cityofalhambra.org by 5:00 p.m.
prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and the phone number you will
use when calling or the name you will use when logging into the meeting. You should then call
or log into the meeting at least 5 minutes prior to its start time. Staff will unmute you and announce
you when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by
the President. If you do not have access to a computer, please call 626-570-5045 to request public
comment.

2) “Raise your hand”: For those members of the public that wish to speak but did not make a request
via email as described above, such members of the public may speak by using the “Raise Hand”
function during the public comments portion, if on Zoom. Staff will unmute you and announce you
when it is your time to speak. If participating via telephone, the President will ask anyone participating
by telephone if they would like to speak after asking those on Zoom. Staff will unmute telephone callers
and you may state you wish to speak.
3) Emailed comments to be read into the record: As an alternative to speaking during the meeting,
you can email your comments to Maria Fregoso at mfregoso@cityofalhambra.org by no later than
5:00 p.m. on November 4, 2021 to ensure that the Administrative Assistant has time to print the emails
prior to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then be read into the record by the Administration
Assistant, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per individual comment, subject to the President’s
discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 p.m. but before the conclusion of the meeting based
upon its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a part of the record of the meeting but will
not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated
should email or call the Parks and Recreation Department at mfregoso@cityofalhambra.org or (626)
570-5045 who will use their best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much
accessibility as possible while also maintaining public safety.

Dated October 28, 2021
Notice No. N2M21-132

  We welcome you to the Parks and Recreation Commission meeting.

  If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and give
  it to the recording secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes.
  If you wish to address the Commission on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments will
  be heard during the Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the Commission on a
  subject which does not appear on the agenda but related to recreation or community service, you may
  make your presentation under Agenda item VI. Please be advised that the Commission cannot, under
  the provisions of the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on any item which does not
  appear on the agenda.

  When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record, and make your
  statement as brief as possible.

  Thank you.

IV.  Tree City USA

 VII.  Commission Orals

  Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business described
  hereinabove are on file in the Department of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First
  Street, Alhambra, California are available for public inspection during regular office hours which are
  Monday through Thursday 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.

  Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the meeting
  described herein, he or she may contact Mr. Michael Macias, Director of Parks & Recreation, either in
  person at the Parks & Recreation Department or by telephone at (626) 570-5044.
